trips.name: Go Ape
trips.blurb: A first-week-back confidence builder in the treetops at Temple Newsam — high ropes, zip wires and a Tarzan swing, twenty minutes from the school gate.

trips.name: Bewerley Park
trips.blurb: The Year 7 residential that turns a hundred new starters into a year group — caving, gorge walking and canoeing in Nidderdale, with the coach and the full centre package handled end to end.

trips.name: Science Live
trips.blurb: A day of lectures from working scientists, with exam-board sessions built in. Venue changes year to year, so we book the tickets and match the transport to wherever it lands.

trips.name: Magna
trips.blurb: Four hands-on pavilions — earth, air, fire and water — inside a vast former steelworks. The Big Melt fires every hour and still makes an entire year group jump.

trips.name: Fountains Abbey
trips.blurb: A World Heritage site an hour up the A1 — the ruined Cistercian abbey and the Studley Royal water garden, walked with a trail the department sets.

trips.name: The Deep
trips.blurb: Europe's deepest viewing tunnel, a colony of Gentoo penguins and a lift that runs up through ten metres of water. Ties straight into the Year 8 ecosystems unit.

trips.name: Halifax
trips.blurb: Urban regeneration fieldwork on the doorstep — the Piece Hall and the surrounding streets as a live case study in how a town centre is remade.

trips.name: Hornsea
trips.blurb: Coastal processes on the fastest-eroding coastline in Europe — groynes, longshore drift and hard engineering measured on the beach rather than drawn on a board.

trips.name: Manchester
trips.blurb: A-level urban fieldwork across the city centre — Ancoats, Spinningfields and the Northern Quarter, comparing three very different answers to the same regeneration question.

trips.name: London
trips.blurb: Down and back by train in a day. Rail booked as a group so the whole cohort travels together, with the itinerary set by the department.

trips.name: Iceland
trips.date: February half term — alternates with Easter
trips.blurb: Plate margins you can walk into. Waterfalls, black sand at Reynisfjara, a glacier snout with a guide and aurora watches every night — flights, transfers and the full ground package.

trips.name: Amalfi Coast
trips.blurb: Pompeii and Herculaneum in the morning, the Amalfi corniche in the afternoon, Vesuvius on the last day — the Humanities trip the sixth form picks its options around.

trips.name: Rome
trips.blurb: St Peter's, the Vatican Museums and the catacombs, with the Colosseum and the Forum either side — the RE syllabus standing up in front of them at full scale.

trips.name: Disneyland Paris
trips.blurb: A design and technology trip disguised as the best week of the year — behind-the-scenes ride engineering and materials workshops, then the park itself.

trips.name: Berlin
trips.blurb: Cold War Berlin end to end — Checkpoint Charlie, the Wall Memorial on Bernauer Straße, the Stasi archive and a Reichstag guide, all inside four days.
